sentences.text: Tafejul Sk. @ Mondal vs Unknown on 17 January, 2023

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
17.01.2023 Serial no.37 Dd Crm (A) 209 of 2023 In re : An Application for Anticipatory Bail under
Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Murutia Police Station Case No.
179 of 2020 dated 04.08.2020 under Sections 498A/325/326/307/34 of the Ipc
-And-
In the matter of : Tafejul Sk. @ Mondal ... ...

Petitioner Ms. Minoti Gomes, Mr. Asraf Mondal,
Advocates ... ...
For the Petitioner Mr. Imran Ali Ms. Debjani Sahu, Advocates ... ...For the State
Petitioner renews the prayer for anticipatory bail.
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the de facto complainant is presently residing at her matrimonial home and expressed desire to resolve the disputes.
In support of such contention she relies upon an affidavit affirmed by the de facto complainant before the Notary Public.
Such affidavit filed in Court be taken on record.
Learned advocate appearing for the State draws the attention of the court to the injury report of the mother of the de facto complainant.

In view of the affidavit affirmed by the de facto complainant before the Notary Public and in view of the stand taken by the petitioner, it would be appropriate to request the de facto complainant and her mother to record statements under Section 164 of the Criminal Procedure Code before the jurisdictional Court.
Police are directed to facilitate such recording.

On the prayer made on behalf of the State and considering the fact that this is the second application for anticipatory bail, it would be appropriate to direct the petitioner to be personally present on such date.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
